I will modify taxsim to use 2022 EIC parameters.

Dan

On Wed, 1 Jul 2026, Pavel Makarchuk wrote:

> PavelMakarchuk left a comment (PolicyEngine/policyengine-taxsim#1034)
>
> PE is correct here. Washington's WFTC freezes the 'maximum qualifying income' at the June 9, 2022 IRC (RCW 82.08.0206(2)), so the single/0-child completed-phaseout AGI is $16,480 (not the current-year $19,104), and this $14,482 filer is $502 into the phaseout ? WFTC $277.76. TAXSIM applies no WA WFTC phaseout and a stale max, so it's the outlier; TaxAct doesn't do WA. No PE change needed. (Note: the issue body links out2psl/1033; the /1034 bundle holds an unrelated CO record.)
